summary: Salt Song is a jazz album by saxophonist Stanley Turrentine, recorded for the CTI Note label. It features Turrentine performing with an orchestra arranged by Eumir Deodato. The CD rerelease includes an additional track.
one_line: Salt Song is a jazz album by saxophonist Stanley Turrentine on the CTI Note label, arranged by Eumir Deodato.
key_facts: Salt Song is an album by jazz saxophonist Stanley Turrentine.
The album was recorded for the CTI Note label.
The album features performances by Stanley Turrentine with an orchestra.
The orchestra on Salt Song was arranged by Eumir Deodato.
The CD rerelease of Salt Song added another track.
